title: Show-planning equipment taxonomy proposal
scope: Core: entertainment lighting, atmosphere, lasers, and stage effects for theatre, bars/clubs, corporate/live events, festivals, arenas, and touring. Broader visual production equipment is marked optional. Audio and backline are out of scope unless separately approved.
principles: Place an asset by its primary equipment function, not by source technology, protocol, venue, or show genre.
Represent LED/tungsten/discharge/laser-phosphor, moving/static, IP rating, beam angle, output, control protocol, power, mounting, and scale as searchable cross-cutting attributes.
An asset may carry multiple application tags (for example frontlight, cyc, scenic wash, audience effect, aerial beam) without duplicating its category.
Keep fixture types, accessories, infrastructure, and virtual-only effects as distinct top-level families.
Every terminal node is an equipment class with representative asset examples; examples illustrate class membership and do not imply catalog availability.

terminal_categories.label: Water, mist, and rain effects

coverage_and_catalog_limitations: This is a category proposal, not a populated model/manufacturer catalog. A representative example is illustrative only.
Do not claim every manufacturer, model, variant, accessory, or fixture personality exists. Track verified catalog coverage separately with source and review date.
Venue scale describes a use context and should be a facet or saved filter, never a competing copy of each category.
Laser, flame, atmospheric, rigging, and water equipment may require jurisdiction-, venue-, or production-specific approvals. This taxonomy makes no safety or legal determination.
Specialty effects such as cryogenic jets, pyro, projection mapping, drones, kinetic scenery, and aerial performers remain backlog until scope and maintenance ownership are agreed.
research_basis: See forum-research.json for source links, visible dates, paraphrased discussion evidence, implications, and limitations.
